utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What would you like me to do?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my toolbox, but I keep forgetting where I set it down. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what repairs the drive is focusing on? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a couple of tools over if that helps, but I don’t have the date, time, or repair list yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira—I appreciate it. I’ll wait for your update and then I can share the plan with Eli and Nell.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure everyone has the updated details. What do you need from me, Quinn?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just keep me posted on what tools or supplies are still needed, and I’ll spread the word fast. I can also invite a few more neighbors if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — do you still need anything for the repair drive, or are you all set?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A couple extra tools would still be really helpful if you can bring them over. That’d make the repair drive go a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d still like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can start at 9:00 AM—just bring gloves, a screwdriver, and any spare parts you have.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list confirmed yet. I can check and get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — just send me the repair list when you have it, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the date, time, and repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I may have missed a few updates, but last I heard they were still collecting stuff for the repair drive. I don’t know the date or time yet.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive pick up any new volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but I can check who’s confirmed and what supplies we still need. Cleo said she can keep track of the supplies, so I’ll loop her in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rey’s offering to help however they can, which is really kind. I’m still gathering the latest on the repair drive, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear any updates about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still nailing that down, but I’ll send you the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. Just let me know the spot and time when you have it.
